description: In constant-free unary languages, matching capacities at \(r\) and matching assignments of length \(n\) give equal truth values for every actual shared formula \(\varphi\) with \(n+q(\varphi)\le r\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.truth_invariance.{u_1, u_2} {k : ℕ} {M : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Structure M]
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Structure N] {r n : ℕ}
  (hcap :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.Capacities r Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.profile
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.profile)
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).BoundedFormula Empty n) (a : Fin n → M) (b : Fin n → N)
  (hmatch :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.Matching Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.profile
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.profile a b)
  (hbudget : n + Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.quantifiers φ ≤ r) :
  φ.Realize Empty.elim a ↔ φ.Realize Empty.elim b
